frozen_claim: Предсказательная сила third-order co-skewness тензора статической FC в отношении cognition — это в основном identifiability-артефакт, а не самостоятельный мгновенный three-way механизм: co-skewness служит ведущим каналом поглощения немоделированных направленных/лаговых (temporal) зависимостей, поэтому при явном учёте directed lagged FC инкрементальный вклад статической co-skewness в предсказание cognition падает почти до нуля.

observable.name: incremental_cv_r2_coskewness_over_directed_fc
observable.definition: Cross-validated R^2 increment of static third-order co-skewness features over a directed/multi-lag functional-connectivity baseline when predicting a cognition target. On a synthetic generative model a single common skewed latent driver is spread to receiver nodes through a shared fixed HRF-like lag-1..3 kernel, and cognition modulates the directed coupling; NO genuine instantaneous three-way interaction term exists by construction. Predictors are fit with Ridge(alpha=1.0) under 5-fold CV; the increment is coskew-augmented model CV-R^2 minus baseline CV-R^2, reported as mean +/- std across 12 fixed seeds. Baselines: static linear FC (poor), few-lag directed FC (poor), and a 6-lag VAR-style directed FC (rich).
observable.source_ref: arXiv:2606.04010 (Marraffini et al.) — seed empirical finding that static co-skewness predicts cognition; the duel tests a mechanistic alternative (leakage of unmodelled directed/temporal structure) on a synthetic sufficiency model, not on the paper's observable as measured on neural data.

model.generative: A single common latent driver with skewed (asymmetric) marginal is spread to 4 receiver nodes via a shared fixed lag-1..3 kernel [[1,0.6],[2,0.3],[3,0.1]] (HRF-like); cognition modulates the directed coupling. A symmetric nuisance source adds shared variance with no skew. By construction there is no instantaneous three-way coupling term: any static co-skewness is induced by the lagged common skewed driver.
model.config: subjects=320, timepoints=300, nodes=4, rich_lags=6, estimator=Ridge(alpha=1.0) with 5-fold CV R^2, 12 fixed seeds (0..11).
model.controls: independent_source regime: same marginal skew but NO common driver, so a genuine-instantaneous-mechanism account would still predict cognition from co-skewness while the leakage account predicts ~0.

thresholds.decision_rule: Mechanistic SUFFICIENCY is supported if, under a common skewed driver, co-skewness alone is clearly predictive (CV-R^2 well above 0, target >= 0.1) yet its incremental CV-R^2 over a directed/multi-lag FC baseline falls within +/- 0.02 of zero, AND in the independent-source control (no common driver) co-skewness carries no prediction (CV-R^2 ~ 0 or below).

nulls: independent_source: same marginal skew but no common driver — co-skewness should carry no cognition prediction under the leakage account.
increment measured by nested cross-validation to avoid optimistic bias.
failure_modes: Synthetic sufficiency cannot establish that real fMRI/BOLD data live in this regime (external validity) — the decisive limitation of this test.
Ridge alpha fixed at 1.0; co-skewness feature dimensionality could inflate or deflate the measured increment.
Only 4 nodes, a single common driver and one symmetric nuisance; a richer real covariance structure could leave a residual increment a directed baseline does not absorb.
Haemodynamic spread approximated by a shared fixed lag-1..3 kernel rather than region-specific HRFs.
The residual increment of co-skewness over a richer directed baseline was reported as small but run-to-run unstable in the transcript and is NOT resolved here.
accepted_evidence_criteria: Sufficiency is supported if co-skewness alone predicts the cognition target (CV-R^2 well above 0) under a common skewed driver while its increment over a directed/multi-lag FC baseline collapses to ~0 (within +/- 0.02), and the no-common-driver control shows co-skewness carries no prediction.
rejected_evidence_criteria: The thesis as a REAL-DATA claim is NOT established by this synthetic test even when sufficiency holds. It would be falsified on real data if static co-skewness retained a substantial, stable incremental CV-R^2 over a properly matched directed/VAR baseline on the same subjects (e.g. HCP), or if co-skewness prediction survived a temporal/phase shuffle that preserves instantaneous marginals.
